questions.workflow-create:
请比较 Retail 两周的渠道实付额，找出差额绝对值最大的渠道。直接用 database_query 执行下面这一条只读 SQL，返回渠道 ID、两期金额和差额（金额单位为分）。仅使用渠道商品日报，无需查表目录、维表或拆商品。

WITH latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (tenant_id, report_date, channel_id, sku_id, region_id) report_date, channel_id, paid_amount_cent FROM core.channel_product_daily WHERE report_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-17' AND DATE '2025-11-23' OR report_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-11-30' ORDER BY tenant_id, report_date, channel_id, sku_id, region_id, report_version DESC ) SELECT channel_id, COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount_cent) FILTER (WHERE report_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-17' AND DATE '2025-11-23'), 0) AS baseline_cent, COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount_cent) FILTER (WHERE report_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-11-30'), 0) AS current_cent FROM latest GROUP BY channel_id ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount_cent) FILTER (WHERE report_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-11-30'), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount_cent) FILTER (WHERE report_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-17' AND DATE '2025-11-23'), 0)) DESC, channel_id LIMIT 1

查到结果后，请立即调用 create_workflow 创建并试跑「两周渠道实付对比」。将两期各自的起止日期设为四个 YYYY-MM-DD 字符串入参，脚本用本次入参填入同一条 SQL，只调度一个 sub_agent，prompt 明确要求直接执行这条 SQL 并返回查询结果。试跑成功后简要汇报结果并提示我确认保存。
